content: We also conduct experiments under a setting with a small number of labeled target examples available. Figure FIGREF27 shows the change of accuracy with respect to the number of labeled target examples added for training. We can observe that DAS is still more effective under this setting, while the performance differences to other methods gradually decrease with the increasing number of labeled target examples.
